title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: users can upload local and OneDrive files to custom engine agents
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing statements and documented control paths and APIs are supported. The remaining upload-specific gaps were confirmed by independent searches. Two minor qualifications would clarify Microsoft's differing descriptions of hosting and compliance for Copilot Studio agents.

claims.where: controls[1].scope and note; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: User access governs tenant-wide access to agents and plugins rather than access to a selected agent or its upload behaviour.
claims.quote: Use User access to control how members of your organization access and install agents and plugins. Select Save to update your Copilot agent and plugin settings for your tenant.

claims.claim: All users is the default User access option.
claims.quote: All users - This option is the default. It means that all users in the organization can access agents and plugins, subject to the existing app policies and user assignments.

claims.claim: No users is a User access UI option.
claims.quote: No users - This option means that no users in the organization can access agents and plugins.

claims.claim: Specific users or groups is a User access UI option.
claims.quote: Specific users or groups - This option lets you select specific users or groups in your organization to have access to agents and plugins.
